positive.prompt: Create a concise handoff for the next agent with exact current state and one next executable step.
The context window will reset soon; package decisions, verification, blockers, and pointers.
Write a continuation brief so another session can resume this unfinished task without the transcript.

negative.prompt: Break the approved spec into dependency-aware tasks for several agent sessions.
Review the current diff against the originating spec and repository standards.

evals.prompt: Hand this unfinished implementation to a fresh session. Important specs and test logs already exist in the repository.
evals.expected_output: A compact continuation brief grounded in verified repository state, using pointers instead of duplicated artifacts and naming the first executable next step.
expectations: The agent inspects repository, branch, working-tree, task, and verification state rather than relying only on conversation memory.
When the repository profile defines continuity locations and update triggers, the authoritative task/context record is refreshed before transfer and any unresolved continuity policy is surfaced.
The handoff distinguishes complete, in-progress, not-started, blocked, and unverified work.
Existing specs, logs, decisions, diffs, and artifacts are referenced rather than copied into a second source of truth.
One immediately executable next step has a clear completion condition.
Secrets, personal data, private endpoints, and irrelevant host-specific paths are absent.
